title: Родители Насти и свидание Шефа  (Nastya's Parents and the Chef's Date)

scenes.title: Тайная гостья за столиком и интервью Елены  (The Mystery Guest at the Table and Elena's Interview)
scenes.summary: Nastya thinks an older woman in the dining room is flirting with Kostya until she realizes it is her own mother, while Chef Barinov fumes over Elena's two-page magazine interview.

scenes.title: Совет от Макса и знакомство с мамой Насти  (Advice from Max and Meeting Nastya's Mom)
scenes.summary: Max teases Chef Barinov about wanting to ask Elena out on a date, and in the dining room Nastya introduces Kostya to her mother.

scenes.title: Приглашение на семейный обед  (Invitation to a Family Dinner)
scenes.summary: Nastya's mother reminds Kostya how he accidentally punched Nastya's father during their last encounter and invites them over on Saturday to make peace—until Nastya invites her parents to their apartment instead.

scenes.title: Неловкие комплименты у ресторана  (Awkward Compliments Outside the Restaurant)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov runs into Elena outside and awkwardly compliments her magazine photo before losing his nerve when she realizes he never read her interview.

scenes.title: Регистрация Шефа в соцсети  (Registering the Chef on Social Media)
scenes.summary: Max shows Chef Barinov Elena's social media profile and offers to register him online so he can ask her out, until Barinov insists on courting women the old-fashioned way.

scenes.title: Причина ссоры Насти с отцом  (The Reason Behind Nastya's Feud with Her Father)
scenes.summary: Nastya explains to Kostya that she left home because her father owns a meatpacking plant and mocked her vegetarian principles.

scenes.title: Костя решает помирить Настю с отцом  (Kostya Decides to Reconcile Nastya with Her Father)
scenes.summary: Finishing her story about walking out of her parents' house without a penny, Nastya gives Kostya her father's phone number so Kostya can invite him to dinner.

scenes.title: Пари на пять тысяч рублей  (A Five-Thousand-Ruble Bet)
scenes.summary: After Chef Barinov chickens out of asking Elena on a date in person, he forces Max to bet him five thousand rubles that he cannot get a date with her.

scenes.title: Вторая стычка с отцом Насти и соцсеть  (Second Clash with Nastya's Father and Social Media)
scenes.summary: Kostya visits Nastya's father at his sausage factory to apologize, only to accidentally break his nose in a sparring demonstration, while Max registers Barinov online.

scenes.title: Цветы от тайного поклонника и допрос Кости  (Flowers from a Secret Admirer and Questioning Kostya)
scenes.summary: Elena calls to thank Viktor Petrovich for the anonymous flowers he sent her, and at home Nastya eagerly asks Kostya how his conversation with her father went.

scenes.title: Сломанный нос и звонок от мамы  (The Broken Nose and the Call from Mom)
scenes.summary: Kostya confesses to a horrified Nastya that he accidentally broke her father's nose during their meeting, right as her mother calls from the hospital.

scenes.title: Сообщение от Елены в сети  (A Message from Elena Online)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov starts to scold Max for creating a social media profile in his name, until a direct message from Elena pops up on the screen.

scenes.title: Переписка с Еленой под диктовку Шефа  (Chatting with Elena at the Chef's Dictation)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov dictates replies to Elena through Max on the laptop, and panics when Max boldly sends her a message inviting her on a date tomorrow.

scenes.title: Выбор места для свидания: в кино  (Choosing a Spot for the Date: The Movies)
scenes.summary: Delighted that Elena agreed to the date, Chef Barinov rejects Max's suggestion of a nightclub and invites Elena to go to the movie theater instead.

scenes.title: Похищение Кости людьми Степана Андреевича  (Kostya's Abduction by Stepan Andreyevich's Men)
scenes.summary: Two burly bodyguards working for Nastya's father bundle Kostya into an SUV, where Stepan Andreyevich surprises him by inviting him to the family dinner to make Nastya happy.

scenes.title: Выбор галстука перед свиданием  (Choosing a Tie Before the Date)
scenes.summary: Before heading to the movies with Elena, a nervous Chef Barinov asks Vika and Lyova whether to wear a red tie or a blue tie, as if defusing a bomb.

scenes.title: Вегетарианский ужин для родителей Насти  (A Vegetarian Dinner for Nastya's Parents)
scenes.summary: Nastya's parents arrive at the apartment for dinner, where Kostya clumsy shatters a plate and Nastya proudly serves her meat-loving father vegetarian cabbage cutlets.

scenes.title: Спор о мясе и котлетах из капусты  (The Argument Over Meat and Cabbage Cutlets)
scenes.summary: Tension boils over at the dinner table when Nastya attacks her father's sausage business as animal cruelty and Stepan Andreyevich explodes that people love real meat.

scenes.title: Мужской разговор на лестнице и коньяк  (Man-to-Man Talk on the Stairs and Cognac)
scenes.summary: When Stepan Andreyevich yells at Nastya, Kostya stands up to him and challenges him to step outside, winning the older man's respect and a shared bottle of cognac.

scenes.title: Прогулка после кино  (The Walk After the Movie)
scenes.summary: Leaving the movie theater together, Elena admits she nearly cried at the ending while Chef Barinov explains the story behind Claude Monet and Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: Поцелуй на прощание и примирение семьи  (A Goodnight Kiss and Family Reconciliation)
scenes.summary: Elena kisses Viktor Petrovich goodnight outside her door, and back at the apartment Kostya and Nastya's father return tipsy and reconciled after feasting on sausage on the stairs.
